lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in at least four identifiable horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region. Centroids exhibit increased spatial separation as they progress towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal spot rows to form a series of primary and secondary nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges display a sharp intensity transition, with high-luminance dorsal surfaces and low-luminance ventral shadowing, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct elongated high-contrast object is visible adjacent to the ventral region near the posterior margin of the pectoral fin, consistent with an associated remora.
